tasks_completed.description: Replaced meals section in generate-html-interactive.py from 3 separate rows to single flat grid
tasks_completed.changes: Lines 2167-2221: Replaced per-meal-type iteration (3 separate sub-sections with labels) with a single flatMap that collects all meal options into one flat grid. Each card now shows a meal type badge (emoji + label) at the top instead of separate section headers.

tasks_completed.description: Fixed surrogate emoji encoding issue in the meals section replacement
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced escaped surrogate pair \ud83c\udf7d\ufe0f with actual Unicode emoji character U+1F37D in the Section icon prop
tasks_completed.rationale: Python string replacement wrote emoji as surrogate escapes which caused UnicodeEncodeError when writing the HTML file.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - plan-skeleton.json was generated with empty location_local values from the initial plan creation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Plan skeleton generator did not populate location_local for Chinese city names, and fetch-images-batch.py requires non-empty location_local to build the city mapping for Gaode Maps searches
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Populated location_local with correct Chinese names so the existing fetch_cities() logic works correctly

dev.qa_notes: Verify at https://travel.life-ai.app/china/2026-04-12/ that: (1) City cover images appear in the hero/header sections for all 5 cities, (2) Meals section shows all 3 meal cards in a single horizontal row (no separate Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner section headers), (3) Shopping section shows real images from Gaode Maps (not default placeholders)

recommendations: Plan skeleton generator should auto-populate location_local for known Chinese cities to prevent this issue recurring
Consider adding a validation step in generate-and-deploy.sh that warns if location_local is empty for any day
